effect: Lagna lord balwan sthiti me hone se aachi vitality, natural immunity aur fast recovery stamina milta hai.

source: Sun in Kendra Vital energy, paraphrased
effect: Surya Arogyakaraka hai; kendra me hone se sharirik tejas, bone health aur prana shakti majboot hoti hai.

source: Moon in 6th or 8th Mental peace and hydration, paraphrased
effect: Chandra dusthana me hone par emotional peace, meditation aur balanced sleep schedule par dhyan dena laabhdayak hai.

source: Saturn in 6th Overcoming ailments through discipline, paraphrased
effect: Shani 6th me rog-shatru par vijay aur disciplined routine se health maintenance karne me sahayak hota hai.
Mangal 6th me hone se high physical endurance aur competitive stamina rehta hai.

source: Jupiter Aspect on 1st House Divine protection, paraphrased
effect: Guru ki Lagna par drishti samagra swasthya aur mental clarity ki raksha karti hai.

source: Rahu in 6th House Resilient immunity, paraphrased
effect: Rahu 6th me bimariyon se ladne ki adbhut shamta aur competitive resilience deta hai.

source: 6th Lord in 1st House Lifestyle care, paraphrased
effect: Rogesh Lagna me hone se regular exercise, balanced diet aur preventative checkups maintain rakhna behtar rehta hai.
Budha 6th me gut health aur nervous balance ke liye routine dietary discipline ki aavashyakta darshata hai.

source: Venus in 6th Balance in sensory pleasures, paraphrased
effect: Shukra 6th me metabolic health ke liye sugar aur processed foods me santulan rakhne ki salah deta hai.
